thread:
deploy-bot: Release v2026.03.18-rc4 -> prod/gateway initiated. Canary 8% (eu-west-1). Running post-deploy smoke suite. Summary: 2/14 synthetic checks failing (kv-probe 503, generate p95 elevated). Console: https://console.redwood.ai/deploy/1797654321 :mag:
emily: Noted spike in kv-probe 503s from canary pool starting 15:46Z. Rate ~1.2%. Affected endpoints: /api/generate and /api/health/check.
lauren: Confirmed. Synthetic probe logs show timeouts hitting our kv service pool (kv-01). I see connection resets in the gateway logs around same timeframe.
ishan: Can we pause the rollout? Recommend hold and pin traffic for gateway routes to previous release v2026.03.16 while we triage.
marta: +1 hold. Will update release notes "paused: kv-probe 503s on canary; investigating cache warmup interaction" so PMs are aware.
deploy-bot: Rolling pause executed by @marta. Canary traffic held at 8%. Pin created to v2026.03.16 for routes: /api/generate, /api/health/* .
sre-oncall: Starting focused synthetic at steady 200rps to canary nodes and running kv-probe at higher frequency. Attaching quick tcpdump and gateway error sample.
emily: paste: ```
[2026-03-22T15:46:08Z] POST /internal/kv/fetch 503 node=kv-01 conn=reset
[2026-03-22T15:46:08Z] POST /api/generate 502 node=gw-canary-2 batchSz=48 kv_latency=320ms
[2026-03-22T15:46:09Z] GET /api/health/check 200 node=gw-canary-1 kv_hit=false
[2026-03-22T15:46:10Z] GET /api/health/check 503 node=gw-canary-2 kv_miss=true
```
ishan: Hypothesis: new runtime change in rc4 increases batch size aggregation for small requests which increases concurrent KV fanout and pushes kv-01 into transient overload. Quick mitigation: reduce max batch aggregation size (from 128 -> 64) and add retry backoff on kv calls. I can push a canary patch to gw-canary-2.
emily: If we can patch only gw-canary-2 that's ideal. Run smoke after 3m of steady traffic. If kv 503s drop below 0.2% and p95 normalizes, we can unpin and resume.
marta: I've updated the public release notes draft to include a short note about the pause. PMs pinged.
deploy-bot: Patch rollout to gw-canary-2 scheduled in 90s. Canary rollback window 12m. Will auto-rollback if kv 503 > 0.5% for 2 minutes.
sre-oncall: Synthetic checks started against gw-canary-2. Alert rule set: kv-503 alert if rate > 0.2% sustained 180s. Collecting histograms.
lauren: Dropping a tiny runbook snippet here for the on-call: 1) Pin routes to previous release; 2) Run targeted canary on single shard; 3) If patch reduces kv 503s, rollout incremental; 4) If not, rollback deployment and collect full traces.
ishan: Patch applied to gw-canary-2. Early telemetry: kv-503s halved within first 45s. Batcher queue depth down. Sending more logs.
emily: Re-running smoke suite now (5m steady). Initial p95 improved from 380ms -> 140ms on gw-canary-2. Good sign.
sre-oncall: Canary shard metrics look stable. kv 503 rate now 0.08% over last 3m. No automated rollback triggered.
marta: Great. Recommend slow resume to 25% and monitor for 30m before full rollout. I'll coordinate with release calendar to keep the change window.
deploy-bot: Rolling resume to 25% scheduled. Pin will remain in place until 30m monitoring window completes.
lauren: Uploading logs and request ids to incident bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/1797654321/kv-503s.log
ishan: After postmortem, propose a small change to default batch aggregation heuristics and add a KV warmup on shard start. Will include in follow-up changelist.
emily: I'll update the quick QA checklist and add an explicit kv-probe step for future smoke runs.
marta: Keeping stakeholders updated. Next status update in 30m or sooner if alerts fire. :satellite_antenna:
